text: Historical 1173 registers the disabled calendar before calling reportCalendars because that collector walks cal.manager.getCalendars. A CalDavCalendar instance used only for a direct request is not enough to enter that registry. The addition unregisters after the successful request; the later removal also removes this setup. Scoped test recommendation: mirror the collector’s discovery path and use cleanup that also runs on failure when adding comparable registry-based tests. This is source and test inspection only. Full Bugzilla and historical review discussion remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran.
title: Register a test calendar when testing manager-based collection
